text:
maya_cs: Heads up — renewal for Glassline due 4/15. They want to shift to net45 and split invoice to Glassline EU (entity B). Pricing stays at $120k/year but client asked for a 9mo term instead of 12. Need PO + signed amendment.
javier_ae: On a call now. They're pushing 9mo at pro-rated price. cc @priya_legal — are we good to do 9mo v1?
priya_legal: We can approve a 9mo amendment if Finance signs off on proration math. Need final SOW amendment + Docusign signer list. Also confirm vendor code for billing entity.
tom_finance: Vendor code missing for Glassline EU. If they want net45 we need vendor code + credit check. If PO arrives that references vendor code we can proceed.
amanda_onboard: Onboarding note — we can provision seats after signature + valid PO. Dev access can be earlier if we get signed NDA.
maya_cs: Sharing draft amendment: https://docsend.com/view/abcd1234 (amendment v1). PO template name: `PO-GL-2026-04`. Please review and flag any legal hooks.
javier_ae: Client wants e-sign routed to CFO Elena Ramos (elena@glassline.co) then ops (ops@glassline.co).
docusign-bot: Envelope created: `env_57321` | status: sent -> elena@glassline.co
priya_legal: Legal asks to keep the "no-liability" clause intact. Amanda — please ensure SOW amendment retains the clause. Also ask client whether they require customer-managed KMS (if so, we need key_id).
amanda_onboard: `SOW_amendment_v1` updated with clause. Pushing to Docusign tabs now.
tom_finance: Quick checklist: PO must include vendor code + total. If PO not received today we'll place account on credit hold. @maya_cs confirm client commit.
maya_cs: Client verbally confirmed they'll send PO this afternoon. They're preparing vendor code with procurement. I'll chase.
javier_ae: If PO is late, can we offer 30-day interim provisioning (dev-only)? Ops needs to confirm.
amanda_onboard: We can provide dev tokens for 30 days (no prod). Prod access remains pending signature/PO.
maya_cs: Noted — I'll offer dev access to keep momentum.
[~3 hours later]
docusign-bot: Envelope `env_57321` signed by elena@glassline.co at 2026-04-10T15:12Z
maya_cs: Received signed amendment and uploaded to CRM. PO arrived: `PO-GL-2026-04-5678.pdf` (vendor code GL-INTL included). Forwarded to finance.
tom_finance: Verified vendor code GL-INTL and invoice amount. Payment terms set to net45. Creating invoice schedule now.
amanda_onboard: Provisioning kicked off — seat assignments queued, provisioning ETA ~48hrs.
javier_ae: Loop-closing question: any remaining blockers from legal/finance/ops?
priya_legal: No legal blockers. SOW clause confirmed.
maya_cs: :thumbsup: Closing on our side. Logging renewal as complete in CRM and updating renewal risk board.
thread_summary: Glassline renewal: 9mo amendment, net45, PO arrival, Docusign route to CFO, vendor code check, onboarding provisioning.
